[[File:Goshien.jpg|thumb|right|Members of the Goshien [[Aiel]].]]

The '''Goshien''' clan is one of the twelve [[Aiel]] clans. They had a standing blood feud with the [[Shaarad]] clan until, under Rand's ''[[ta'veren]]'' influence, the clan chiefs mended fences. They are one of the first clans to have joined with Rand, reaching [[Alcair Dal]] before him. They are supportive of Rand and his cause and are sent to Arad Doman to restore order. Their clan hold is [[Smoke Springs Hold]], of which [[Dorindha_%28Roofmistress%29|Dorindha]] is the Roofmistress.
